payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort a copy of the array, then iterate to count indices where original and sorted differ. If mismatches <= 2, array can be sorted with at most one swap.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the array to obtain the target sorted order, then compares with original to count elements out of place. This fits the sorting_custom_key subtype as it leverages sorting to solve a swap-sorting check. No binary search or sweep line occurs.
